product.name: Kinnaur walnut kernels
product.shortDescription: Sun-dried high-altitude Kinnauri walnuts with tender golden skins, rich natural oils, and sweet buttery crunch.
product.imageAlt: Walnuts in their shells, one cracked open
product.description:
Harvested from heritage mountain orchards in the glacier-fed valleys of Kinnaur, perched at 2,800 metres above sea level. The intense Himalayan sunlight and freezing alpine nights stimulate the trees to produce nuts packed with extraordinary healthy oil reserves.

Each walnut is hand-gathered by local grower families, cracked manually on wooden mallets, and sun-dried on natural slate stone. We never subject our kernels to chlorine bleaching, preserving their wholesome golden-amber pellicle and sweet earthy finish.
